body:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

Reproducer: 
python test/inductor/test_flex_attention.py TestFlexAttentionCUDA.test_flex_attention_stride_ordering_mode_paged_attention_permute_order3_shape0_cuda  
Platform: **H100/H200** (and potentially other platforms). 
Reproducer (the person) used an aarch64 based H100 (i.e. the CPU architecture is aarch64)
**Note: tested on a x86 based H100, it did not have the IMA failure.** 
**Another Note: this does not reproduce on a Grace Hopper (Grace/ARM CPU + H200) either.**
